description: Remove one Editorial Circle link from an article on your site. RankControl republishes that article without the link, and the partner loses it. A link you received stays until the site that hosts it removes it. Dry run unless confirm is true; a confirmed call waits for the workspace owner to approve it in RankControl. Placement ids come from get_editorial_circle.

confirm.description: Set true to remove the link (default: dry run)

name: remove_editorial_circle_placement
